youtube_description:
Noreen Joyce Guerra was once a huge K-drama fan in the Philippines. 

Years later, she is now living her dreams by having a successful career at a Korean company on weekdays, and appearing in dozens of popular Korean dramas herself mostly as a background actor and also hosting TV shows and events with K-pop bands on weekends. 

Intrigued to find out how she does all this?

Check out our video interview with Joyce from the Philippines!!

#filipinosinkorea #kdramafan #filipinoactorinkorea
